caption:
Holiday shopping tip. 🎁

Before you check out, pay with a credit card rather than a debit card when you can. Disputes on card charges are usually easier.

Never pay anyone in gift cards. Real businesses don't ask for that.

Check your own card's terms.

Any shopping safety tip you swear by?
